notable_absence.finding: No Enterprise/Community edition badges appear on this page (the batch's flagged recurring anomaly is absent here) - all gating on this page is by Support Plan tier (Basic/Developer Pro/Enterprise) or free-vs-paid billing tier, never by product edition, consistent with the background note that Capella has no discrete edition concept.

cross_component_finding: create-account.md is mostly onboarding/marketing prose as the hypothesis predicted, but it surfaces two real facts worth capturing: (1) a new organization-scoped role, Project Creator, gating cluster create/turn-on actions alongside the already-known Organization Owner - not previously seen in the SQL++ statement reference batches, which only ever cited Organization Owner/Project Owner/Project Data Writer; and (2) the first page in this batch to name a specific Support Plan tier (Developer Pro) beyond the already-registered Enterprise Support Plan, confirming the plan: namespace has at least three tiers (Basic, Developer Pro, Enterprise) per cloud/billing/billing.md, and that support-plan gating (unlike the free/paid billing-tier gating on the same page) is used for capability-tier features like the Health Advisor dashboard rather than for feature availability alone.
